data.one_liner: An auto-refreshing http client that manages authentication tokens transparently.
data.what_it_does: Wraps package:http to handle token-based authentication automatically. It refreshes expired tokens proactively or on 401 responses, retries requests, and manages single-flight token refreshes concurrently.
use_when: You need automatic token refresh on 401 responses using package:http.
You want concurrent requests to share a single token refresh call.
You need to stream authentication status changes for app routing.
avoid_when: You are using the dio package instead of package:http for your networking layer.
You do not use token-based authentication.
strengths: Handles single-flight refresh to prevent duplicate concurrent refresh calls.
Provides pluggable token storage for secure persistence.
Exposes an authentication status stream for reactive UI routing.
weaknesses: Requires custom implementation of token persistence (InMemoryTokenStorage is non-persistent).

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use vanilla http if you do not need automated authentication token refreshing and want a simpler lower-level client.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use dio if you prefer an alternative full-featured HTTP client with its own interceptors and ecosystem instead of package:http.
